stick.gimbal.name: Base
stick.gimbal.note: grip mounting shaft on top of the base (X/Y gimbal)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-12), WarBRD base (no grip) seen from the front-left and above: square housing with the grip mounting shaft on top, cross-shaped desk plate
mappingSource: catalog: base axes X/Y (roll/pitch), sources EDRefCard devices list (https://www.edrefcard.info/devices) and Virpil support WarBRD article https://support.virpil.com/en/support/solutions/articles/47001285160-vpc-warbrd-grip; the base has no buttons
note: the only part is the gimbal; its marker sits on the grip mounting shaft on top of the base (where the stick pivots).
